title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American run that will bring her back to the United States and Canada in spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American run that will bring her back to the United States and Canada in spring 2027. The dates arrive after a year spent rebuilding a live schedule she had cleared completely in 2025.

Young stepped away after collapsing during her set at All Things Go in New York in September 2025. She later told fans she was cancelling "everything for the foreseeable future" and needed time away, wiping out a sold-out UK tour and the North American shows that had been planned around *I'm Only F**king Myself*.

The return came gradually. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance at the Grammys in February, where she also performed the song. Headline shows in the UK and festival appearances followed, and in September she returned to All Things Go roughly a year after the New York performance that preceded her break.

Her May single "From Down Here" also gave the comeback new material. Created with James Blake after inspiration hit the day following the Grammys, the song followed *I'm Only F**king Myself* without simply extending the mood of that record. Young described writing it from the strange position of missing an old high while learning to value being grounded.

Everything Begins opens in Nashville on April 6 and closes in Los Angeles on May 4. Presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time.

The tour name comes from Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo. In the note that accompanied her 2025 cancellations, she asked fans for "a second chance" after taking time to work on herself. For the 2027 tour, she has flipped the tattoo's wording into Everything Begins.
